g.text: Read downwards: order, not elapsed time. Dashed verticals: lifelines.
Solid arrows: actions; dashed arrow: reported outcome; bent arrows: local work.
Blue boxes: Ravel processes. Grey box: caller. Bars group related steps.
This example sends INT directly to the front; it is not keyboard delivery.
HUP and TERM give shell statuses 129 and 143 by the same cancellation rule.
A failed signal propagation uses the corresponding numeric exit as fallback.
Cancellation reports attempted teardown, not a guarantee that cleanup succeeded.
